description: This file defines a custom Swing JTextField subclass that allows specifying a fixed width, regardless of the content.

classes.name: JTextFieldWithWidth
classes.description: A subclass of JTextField that overrides getPreferredSize to enforce a fixed width specified at construction.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth
methods.description: Constructs a JTextFieldWithWidth with specified width or default values.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Overrides the default method to return a Dimension with the specified fixed width.
